#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# healthcheck.sh — Service Health Check Script
#
# Checks whether services are responding on ports 3000 and 8080 and reports
# their status. Exits with code 0 if ALL services are healthy, 1 otherwise.
# =============================================================================

# ── Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HOST="${HOST:-localhost}"
TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-5}"          # seconds to wait for a response
HEALTH_ENDPOINT="/health"        # path to probe (falls back to plain TCP)

declare -A SERVICE_NAMES=(
  [3000]="App Server  (port 3000)"
  [8080]="API Gateway (port 8080)"
)
PORTS=(3000 8080)

# ── Colours (disabled automatically when output is not a terminal) ────────────
if [[ -t 1 ]]; then
  RED="\033[0;31m"
  GREEN="\033[0;32m"
  YELLOW="\033[0;33m"
  CYAN="\033[0;36m"
  BOLD="\033[1m"
  RESET="\033[0m"
else
  RED="" GREEN="" YELLOW="" CYAN="" BOLD="" RESET=""
fi

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
timestamp() { date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"; }

print_header() {
  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}"
  echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
  echo "║           SERVICE HEALTH CHECK               ║"
  echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
  echo -e "${RESET}  Host    : ${HOST}"
  echo    "  Timeout : ${TIMEOUT}s"
  echo    "  Time    : $(timestamp)"
  echo
}

print_result() {
  local port="$1"
  local status="$2"   # UP | DOWN | DEGRADED
  local detail="$3"
  local name="${SERVICE_NAMES[$port]}"

  case "$status" in
    UP)       icon="✔" colour="${GREEN}" ;;
    DOWN)     icon="✘" colour="${RED}"   ;;
    DEGRADED) icon="⚠" colour="${YELLOW}";;
    *)        icon="?" colour="${RESET}" ;;
  esac

  printf "  ${colour}${BOLD}[%s] %-28s${RESET}  %s\n" \
    "$icon" "$name" "$detail"
}

# Check HTTP/HTTPS endpoint; falls back to a raw TCP probe
# Returns: 0 = UP, 1 = DOWN, 2 = DEGRADED (port open but unexpected HTTP code)
check_port() {
  local port="$1"
  local url="http://${HOST}:${port}${HEALTH_ENDPOINT}"

  # ── Try HTTP first ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if command -v curl &>/dev/null; then
    http_code=$(curl --silent --output /dev/null \
                     --write-out "%{http_code}" \
                     --max-time "${TIMEOUT}" \
                     "${url}" 2>/dev/null)
    curl_exit=$?

    if [[ $curl_exit -eq 0 ]]; then
      if [[ "$http_code" =~ ^2 ]]; then
        echo "UP|HTTP ${http_code} on ${url}"
        return 0
      elif [[ "$http_code" =~ ^[345] ]]; then
        echo "DEGRADED|HTTP ${http_code} on ${url}"
        return 2
      fi
    fi

    # curl failed — fall through to TCP probe
  fi

  # ── TCP fallback (nc or /dev/tcp) ───────────────────────────────────────────
  if command -v nc &>/dev/null; then
    if nc -z -w "${TIMEOUT}" "${HOST}" "${port}" &>/dev/null; then
      echo "UP|TCP connection accepted on port ${port} (no HTTP response)"
      return 0
    fi
  else
    # Pure-bash TCP probe via /dev/tcp
    if timeout "${TIMEOUT}" bash -c \
         "echo >/dev/tcp/${HOST}/${port}" &>/dev/null; then
      echo "UP|TCP connection accepted on port ${port} (no HTTP response)"
      return 0
    fi
  fi

  echo "DOWN|No response on ${HOST}:${port} after ${TIMEOUT}s"
  return 1
}

# ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
main() {
  print_header

  all_up=true
  declare -A results

  for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
    raw=$(check_port "$port")
    status="${raw%%|*}"
    detail="${raw#*|}"
    results[$port]="${status}|${detail}"

    [[ "$status" != "UP" ]] && all_up=false
  done

  # ── Report ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  echo -e "  ${BOLD}Service Status${RESET}"
  echo    "  ─────────────────────────────────────────────"
  for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
    status="${results[$port]%%|*}"
    detail="${results[$port]#*|}"
    print_result "$port" "$status" "$detail"
  done
  echo    "  ─────────────────────────────────────────────"

  # ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  echo
  if $all_up; then
    echo -e "  ${GREEN}${BOLD}Overall: ALL SERVICES HEALTHY${RESET}"
    echo
    exit 0
  else
    echo -e "  ${RED}${BOLD}Overall: ONE OR MORE SERVICES ARE DOWN${RESET}"
    echo
    exit 1
  fi
}

main "$@"

  RESET="\033[0m"

  echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
  echo "║           SERVICE HEALTH CHECK               ║"
  echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
  echo -e "${RESET}"
  echo -e "  ${BOLD}Host   :${RESET} ${HOST}"
  echo -e "  ${BOLD}Timeout:${RESET} ${TIMEOUT}s"
  echo -e "  ${BOLD}Time   :${RESET} $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')"
  echo ""
}

print_footer() {
  local healthy=$1 total=$2
  echo ""
  echo "──────────────────────────────────────────────"
  if [ "$healthy" -eq "$total" ]; then
    echo -e "  ${BOLD}${GREEN}All ${total}/${total} services are healthy ✔${RESET}"
  else
    local unhealthy=$(( total - healthy ))
    echo -e "  ${BOLD}${RED}${unhealthy}/${total} service(s) are unhealthy ✘${RESET}"
  fi
  echo "──────────────────────────────────────────────"
  echo ""
}

# Check a single port; returns 0 if healthy, 1 if not.
check_port() {
  local port=$1
  local http_code response_time

  # Capture HTTP status code and total time via curl
  read -r http_code response_time < <(
    curl --silent \
         --output /dev/null \
         --max-time "${TIMEOUT}" \
         --connect-timeout "${TIMEOUT}" \
         --write-out "%{http_code} %{time_total}" \
         "http://${HOST}:${port}/" 2>/dev/null

    return 1
  fi
}

main() {
  print_header

  local healthy=0

    local name="${SERVICES[$port]}"

    fi
  done

  echo "============================================="
  echo "         SERVICE HEALTH CHECK REPORT         "
  echo "=============================================${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Host    : ${BOLD}${HOST}${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Timeout : ${BOLD}${TIMEOUT}s${RESET}"
  echo -e "  Time    : ${BOLD}$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')${RESET}"

print_footer() {
  local passed=$1 failed=$2 total=$3
  echo "---------------------------------------------"
  echo -e "  Results : ${GREEN}${passed} UP${RESET} / ${RED}${failed} DOWN${RESET} / ${BOLD}${total} total${RESET}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}=============================================${RESET}"
}

check_port() {
  local port=$1

  if command -v curl &>/dev/null; then
    curl --silent \
         --output /dev/null \
         --max-time "${TIMEOUT}" \
         "http://${HOST}:${port}" 2>/dev/null
  else
    # Bash built-in TCP check (no curl required)
    timeout "${TIMEOUT}" bash -c \
      ">/dev/tcp/${HOST}/${port}" 2>/dev/null
  fi
}

report_status() {
  local port=$1 service=$2 exit_code=$3 response_time=$4

  if [ "${exit_code}" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "  ${GREEN}[  UP  ]${RESET} ${BOLD}${service}${RESET} (port ${port}) — responded in ${response_time}ms"
  else
    echo -e "  ${RED}[ DOWN ]${RESET} ${BOLD}${service}${RESET} (port ${port}) — no response after ${TIMEOUT}s"
  fi
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
main() {
  print_header

  local passed=0 failed=0 total=0

  # Iterate ports in numeric order for consistent output
  for port in $(echo "${!SERVICES[@]}" | tr ' ' '\n' | sort -n); do
    service="${SERVICES[$port]}"
    total=$(( total + 1 ))

    # Time the check in milliseconds

    check_port "${port}"
    exit_code=$?
    end_ms=$(date +%s%3N 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    response_time=$(( end_ms - start_ms ))

    if [ "${exit_code}" -eq 0 ]; then
      passed=$(( passed + 1 ))
    else
      failed=$(( failed + 1 ))
    fi
  done

  print_footer "${passed}" "${failed}" "${total}"

  # Exit 1 if any service is down so CI/CD pipelines can detect failures

}

  BOLD="\033[1m"
  RESET="\033[0m"

print_header() {
  echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}"
  echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════════╗"

  echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════════╝"

  echo -e "  ${BOLD}Host      :${RESET} ${HOST}"
  echo -e "  ${BOLD}Timeout   :${RESET} ${TIMEOUT}s"
  echo ""
}

# check_port <port> <service_name>
# Returns 0 (healthy) or 1 (unhealthy) and sets CHECK_LATENCY_MS
check_port() {
  local port="$1"
  local start end
  start=$(date +%s%3N 2>/dev/null || date +%s)   # milliseconds, fallback seconds

    HTTP_STATUS=$(curl --silent --output /dev/null \
                       --write-out "%{http_code}" \
                       --max-time "${TIMEOUT}" \
                       "http://${HOST}:${port}" 2>/dev/null) || HTTP_STATUS="000"
    end=$(date +%s%3N 2>/dev/null || date +%s)
    CHECK_LATENCY_MS=$(( end - start ))

    # Any response (even 4xx/5xx) means the port is open and a service answered
    if [[ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "000" ]]; then
      CHECK_HTTP_STATUS="$HTTP_STATUS"
      return 0
    fi

    if nc -z -w "${TIMEOUT}" "${HOST}" "${port}" &>/dev/null; then
      end=$(date +%s%3N 2>/dev/null || date +%s)
      CHECK_LATENCY_MS=$(( end - start ))
      CHECK_HTTP_STATUS="N/A (TCP only)"
      return 0
    fi

    if (echo >/dev/tcp/"${HOST}"/"${port}") &>/dev/null; then
      end=$(date +%s%3N 2>/dev/null || date +%s)
      CHECK_LATENCY_MS=$(( end - start ))
      CHECK_HTTP_STATUS="N/A (TCP only)"
      return 0
    fi
  fi

  end=$(date +%s%3N 2>/dev/null || date +%s)
  CHECK_LATENCY_MS=$(( end - start ))
  CHECK_HTTP_STATUS="N/A"
  return 1
}

PASS=0
FAIL=0

  CHECK_LATENCY_MS=0

    (( FAIL++ ))
  fi
  echo ""
done

TOTAL=$(( PASS + FAIL ))
echo -e "${BOLD}──────────────────────────────────────────────${RESET}"
echo -e "  ${BOLD}Summary:${RESET} ${PASS}/${TOTAL} services healthy"
echo ""

if [[ $FAIL -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo -e "  ${GREEN}${BOLD}✔  All services are up and running.${RESET}"
  EXIT_CODE=0
elif [[ $PASS -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo -e "  ${RED}${BOLD}✘  All services are down!${RESET}"
  EXIT_CODE=2
else
  echo -e "  ${YELLOW}${BOLD}⚠  Some services are unavailable.${RESET}"
  EXIT_CODE=1
fi

echo ""
exit $EXIT_CODE
